headline: Sensex Surges 898 Points as Banking Stocks Lead Strong Rally Defying Global AI Selloff

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking stocks led a major market rally, pushing Sensex up by 898 points.
Foreign inflows lifted domestic equity markets during the trading session.
Banking and IT stocks supported a strong recovery from lower morning levels.
Indian stock markets managed to buck the global selloff caused by a rout in US tech and AI stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 898 points while Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,800 level.
Markets initially opened lower following weakness in global markets and falling gold prices.
SEBI approved IPO proposals for Arohan Financial Services and Pristine Logistics.
SEBI proposed capping the tenure of chief executives and independent directors at stock exchanges.
summary: Indian benchmark indices rebounded sharply on November 20, 2026, with Sensex jumping 898 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800. The recovery was led by gains in banking and IT stocks alongside strong foreign inflows, defying a global tech selloff. Meanwhile, SEBI approved IPO filings for Arohan Financial Services and Pristine Logistics.
